page.title: The right cleaning for you.
page.subtitle: For your home, your move and your workplace. Choose a service and tell us what you need help with.

ui.ctaText: Tell us a little about your home or workplace and we'll get back to you with a proposal.

catalog.title: Home cleaning
catalog.short: Recurring help for an easier everyday life.
catalog.intro: Regular cleaning every week, every other week or once a month. The same careful routine every time, so you come home to a clean and pleasant home.
included: Kitchen cleaning: wiping down surfaces, cleaning exterior of appliances

catalog.title: Move-out cleaning
catalog.short: Leave it clean and focus on your new home.
catalog.intro: Comprehensive cleaning when you move in or out, so the home is ready for its next chapter and you can put your energy into the move.
included: Removing any remaining dust or debris

catalog.title: Deep cleaning
catalog.short: A more thorough pass through your home.
catalog.intro: A more thorough version of home cleaning, for when the details need extra care – before a holiday, after a renovation or simply when it's needed.

catalog.title: Window cleaning
catalog.short: Clean windows that let in more light.
catalog.intro: We clean your windows so more daylight reaches your home. Book it on its own or as an add-on to other cleaning.
included: Cleaning mirrors and glass surfaces when needed

catalog.title: Office cleaning
catalog.short: A fresh workplace for colleagues and visitors.
catalog.intro: Tailored cleaning for office environments, planned to disrupt your workday as little as possible.
included: Custom cleaning plans to meet the needs of your office
Vacuuming and mopping of office floors
Cleaning and disinfecting workspaces, including desks, chairs and common areas
Restroom cleaning and restocking of supplies
Kitchen area cleaning, including appliances and surfaces
Flexible scheduling to minimize disruption to your workday

catalog.title: Extra help
catalog.short: Complement your cleaning to fit your needs.
catalog.intro: Add-on services that complement your cleaning. If you have other requests, we're happy to listen.
included: Fridge cleaning: all shelves, drawers and surfaces
Oven cleaning: inside, racks and door
Custom requests based on your needs
